browse.title: Genny — Network Wishes
browse.description: What's missing from the network? Wish for it here — the most endorsed wishes will guide new organizations joining.

wishCard.fixedNote: After the first endorsement the wish is set — any edit becomes a new wish.
wishCard.editableNote: Before the first endorsement you can edit, withdraw, or delete.

browse.note: Each organization endorses a wish once — and can remove its endorsement at any time. The Shahamham team returns to this list while reviewing new membership applications.
browse.noteBold: A membership request for a specific organization belongs in Hakima, not here.

myWishes.title: Genny — My Wishes
myWishes.description: Mishkaa's wishes — and who stood by it.

addWish.title: New wish
addWish.subtitle: Wish for types of organizations, services, or activities you'd love the network to have.
addWish.dupeLabel: Check first — does the wish already exist?
addWish.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Shared woodworking workshop for set designs
addWish.descriptionPlaceholder: What exactly is the need? Who benefits?
addWish.impactLabel: Why will this strengthen the network?
addWish.impactPlaceholder: Link it to a recurring need — unfulfilled Got Qalish requests are good evidence.
addWish.tip1: Genny is for shared needs — a membership request for a specific org belongs in Hakima during the membership cycle.
addWish.tip2: If you find a similar wish, endorse it instead — collective endorsements speak louder.
addWish.tip3: Before the first endorsement you can edit, withdraw, or delete — after that the wish is set.
addWish.titleMin: Title must be at least 3 characters
addWish.descriptionMin: Description must be at least 10 characters
